def test_process_response():
    from rich.prompt import Prompt, InvalidResponse
    
    # Case sensitive
    p_sensitive = Prompt()
    p_sensitive.choices = ["Paul", "Jessica", "Duncan"]
    p_sensitive.case_sensitive = True
    
    assert p_sensitive.process_response("Paul") == "Paul"
    try:
        p_sensitive.process_response("paul")
        assert False, "Should have raised InvalidResponse"
    except InvalidResponse:
        pass

    # Case insensitive
    p_insensitive = Prompt()
    p_insensitive.choices = ["Paul", "Jessica", "Duncan"]
    p_insensitive.case_sensitive = False
    
    assert p_insensitive.process_response("Paul") == "Paul"
    assert p_insensitive.process_response("paul") == "paul"
    assert p_insensitive.process_response("PAUL") == "PAUL"
    try:
        p_insensitive.process_response("Bob")
        assert False, "Should have raised InvalidResponse"
    except InvalidResponse:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_process_response()
    print("Tests passed!")
